# 3 bed house for sale

> DNG Estate Agents are proud to present "Monatrea" a detached bungalow which occupies a prime location on the periphery of Celbridge village. This fine home offers prospective purchasers a rare opportunity to acquire a property on a wonderful secluded site which is positioned well back from the road and offers incredible privacy with large wrap around gardens providing an ideal setting.

## Fakta
- Typ: house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Plocha: 146 m²
- Energetická náročnost: C
- Lokalita: Monatrea, Maynooth Road, Celbridge
- Cena: 800 000 €
